adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` that does not read `params` and just re-serializes `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`), so the PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` endpoint is effectively a no-op. The client controller includes `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would hit that no-op endpoint. However, the UI shown in `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` doesn’t invoke `saveChanges`, and the only real persistence happens per-host via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save` / `destroyRecord`). So it’s more an API/architecture smell (misleading/unnecessary write endpoint) than a demonstrable broken behavior in this diff.
